correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Fourier kernel k_n,t(j)=(1/n) sum_m cos(2pi*m*j/n)/(1+16t sin^4(pi m/n)), with row sum 1. For n>=5 L_n^2 has distance-two positive coefficient so kernel initially negative, while t->infty kernel is positive mean projector. Scale t=c*n^4; continuum periodic Green G_c has critical c*=1/(64rho^4), rho in (pi/2,pi) solving tan rho+tanh rho=0; at c* unique quadratic zero at antipode, G_c>0 for c>c*. Expand discrete fourth symbol to order n^-2 uniformly by summable O(m^-2) difference and show F_n(c,j)=G_c(j/n)+n^-2 H_c(j/n)+o(n^-2). At c=c*+tau/n² antipodal local minimum is Gamma*tau+H+K*(j-n/2)^2/2+o(1); allowed nearest offsets are 0 for even n and 1/2 for odd n. Thus beta_even=tanh(rho)*(3-rho*tanh(rho))/(48rho³)>0 and beta_odd=-tanh(rho)^2/(48rho²)<0. Away from the antipode strict continuum positivity and for sufficiently large c Fourier tail bound control the entire EVENTUAL threshold. Independently numerically inverted Fourier circulants at n=40,41,80,81,150,151,300,301 and estimated (threshold-c*n^4)/n², converging to the two opposite-sign coefficients; finite support only. Did not assume finite window proves global monotonicity.
